default/31627.htm.text: Information Broker Mist: Who do you think you are? Can't you see I'm spending quality time with my granddaughter? You just couldn't resist, eh? Hmm... You've got a good eye! She's very pretty, isn't she?! Her name's Lilly. Her parents died when she was quite young! I've raised her as my own... She'…

Q00037_MakeFormalWear/31627-01.html.text: Information Broker Mist: Do you have the wine I ordered?

Q00037_MakeFormalWear/31627-03.html.text: Information Broker Mist: Why are you back? Don't bother me! Speak with Jeremy !

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/1-01.htm.text: Information Broker Mist: Quick freeze device? Master Duroga sent you, eh? Hmm... Well, this is essential for enjoying sherbert after a dip in the hot springs... But since I owe Duroga a favor, I suppose I can lend it to you. Unfortunately, it's power source is all but depleted right now.

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/1-03.htm.text: Information Broker Mist: Ah, you have finally brought an Ice Crystal! Give it to me.
